drafts.rides: your own "stuck with Copilot" quote post (12.9K, star) + @sama Private Inference (1.61M)
drafts.text:
Follow-up to my "stuck with Copilot" take.

The gap usually isn't the model. It's the context.

Copilot in Outlook already has the thread. ChatGPT only gets what you pasted.

Try it: same thread, same question, "what did I miss?" Then tell me who's behind.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 10s split screen: left, Copilot in Outlook summarizing a long thread in one click; right, you scrolling and copy-pasting the same thread into a chat box. Caption: 'Same question. Different context.'

drafts.rides: @simonw "Your post on [summary] caught my eye" emails (61K, new today)
drafts.text:
Simon Willison's inbox: "Your post on [summary of my own post] caught my eye."

That's the AI outreach tell now. Your own work, summarized back to you as flattery.

Building outreach agents in Copilot Studio? Put one step before Send: a human reads it. Boring. Cheap. Saves your name.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: you open an email, read the first line out loud in a flat voice, slowly close the laptop. Caption: 'Add a human before Send.'

drafts.rides: @gdb GPT-6.2 interactive history lessons (87K, new today)
drafts.text:
GPT-6.2 can build interactive history lessons now.

The history lesson every Power Platform admin actually needs: who built this flow in 2019, why it emails a mailbox nobody reads, and what breaks if we turn it off.

Document your flows. Future you is the student.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: dramatic documentary zoom on an old flow named 'Flow 7 (copy) FINAL', narrator voice: 'No one knows who built it.' Caption: 'Document your flows.'

drafts.rides: @mustafasuleyman "The model is the product" (152K) + "things are just getting started" (502K)
drafts.text:
"The model is the product." Mustafa Suleyman.

For anyone shipping agents at work, I'd add two lines:

The instructions are the warranty.
The eval set is the receipt.

No receipt, no return when it goes sideways.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 6s: you hold up three cards in turn, 'model', 'instructions', 'evals', and staple a receipt to the last one. Caption: 'Keep the receipt.'
